## Feature Goal
The second-quantized operator stack supports fermionic, spin, and vibrational operators, but it does not provide a first-class bosonic operator or a boson-to-qubit mapper. 1. The new bosonic operator must represent weighted sums of bosonic creation and annihilation terms using sparse labels with mode indices.

## Feature Goal
The TSP application can model complete geometric traveling-salesman instances, but it assumes every pair of nodes is connected.
